data.name: Nibal
data.gender_notes: Nibal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root n-b-l, meaning 'to be firm, steadfast, strong'. In Islamic history, Nibal refers to a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for his unwavering faith. The name Nibal carries the meaning “Strong, Firm” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nibal usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, firm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying strength and resilience in the face of adversity, inspired by the unyielding faith of the Prophet's companion Nibal.
data.etymology: Nibal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Firm.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nibal total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
